forecast-period.text: A high pressure system moves into the west on Friday and continues moving slowly eastwards to be situated in the Tasman Sea on Sunday. A low pressure system and associated trough move into the far west on Sunday and then moves across the state on Monday.
For latest warnings go to www.bom.gov.au, subscribe to RSS feeds, call 1300 659 210* or listen for warnings on relevant TV and radio broadcasts.
* Calls to 1300 numbers cost around 27.5c incl. GST, higher from mobiles or public phones.

Early morning fog about parts of the Agricultural Areas, West Coast and adjacent North West Pastoral districts. Possible early morning frost about the Flinders and Mid North districts. Showers about the north, clearing during the evening. Isolated light showers about the Agricultural Areas. Maximum temperatures below average. South to southeasterly winds, tending westerly in the southeast.

Early morning fog about the Agricultural Area and adjacent West Coast and Pastoral districts. Possible early morning frost about the Flinders and Mid North districts. Isolated light showers about the Southern Agricultural Area, most likely about windward coasts and ranges, clearing by the evening. Isolated showers and possible thunderstorms about the far northwest. Maximum temperatures below average, tending near average about the Southern Agricultural Area. Southeast to northeasterly winds, tending westerly in the southeast.

Early morning fog on and east of the ranges and in the southeast. Possible early morning frost about the southeast and Flinders district. Showers about the far west extending across the west during the day, tending to rain about the far northwest. Possible thunderstorms about the northwest and far west. Maximum temperatures below average about the north, tending near average about the south. Northeast to northerly winds, tending southerly in the far west later.

text.p: Showers extending statewide, tending to rain about parts of the pastoral districts. Possible thunderstorms about the north and west. Maximum temperatures below average. Northeast to northerly winds ahead of a southwest to southerly change extending from the west.

Cumulative rainfall totals to the end of Monday: 1 to 5 mm about the Southern Agricultural Area, 5 to 10 mm about the Northern Agricultural Area, increasing to 10 to 20 mm about the pastoral districts. Isolated falls of 20 to 40 mm are also possible with thunderstorms.
